summary: Established a comprehensive enterprise design system and screen-by-screen information architecture for OncoReady's full product suite. Replaced generic SaaS patterns with operational specificity, a persistent staff application shell, and focused patient/caregiver portals centered around the deterministic state engine.

route_map: / (Public Website: catchy, powerful landing page with perfect UI motion and scroll-driven storytelling, explicitly avoiding SaaS ROI blocks or fake pricing)
/staff/exceptions (Exceptions: working deterministic queue and case workspace)
/patient (Patient Portal: Treatment Readiness focus, no generic EHR screens)
information_architecture.navigation_model: Persistent staff application shell with explicit left-rail navigation for operational depth. Contextual, minimalist top-bar for patient and caregiver portals to minimize cognitive load.

visual_direction.layout: Enterprise-density layouts with explicit structural borders. Eradicated excessive rounded cards, gradients, and unstructured floating panels. Replaced with a crisp, persistent staff application shell and structured data tables. Patient/caregiver views use focused, linear single-column layouts for cognitive clarity.
visual_direction.color: Light background direction maintained (Slate-50 canvases, White panels). Removed generic SaaS gradients and trust-badge rows. Strict, meaningful semantic color usage (Indigo for primary navigation, Amber for active blockers, Emerald for resolved states) with high-contrast text.
visual_direction.typography: Standardized sizing. Eliminated tiny uppercase labels. Utilized robust headings for clear content hierarchy and tabular figures for clinical data, identifiers, and temporal metrics.
visual_direction.spacing_and_shape: Sharp, intentional geometry (4px/8px radii maximum, no excessive pill shapes). Dense information packing for staff (4px grid), breathable pacing for patients (8px grid). Strong use of 1px borders instead of generic drop shadows.
visual_direction.component_presentation: Signature elements: Treatment Readiness Graph (core workflow anchor), Owned Action Workflow panels, Caregiver Permission Boundaries, and the Causal Audit Timeline. Avoided repetitive feature grids, unverified Unsplash portraits, and artificial role-cards.

motion.strategy: Perfect UI animation balancing visual flair with functional performance. Purposeful motion over decoration, utilizing 200-500ms optimal speeds to guide the user's eye and provide feedback without feeling sluggish.
motion.landing_page_animations: Powerful, catchy animations on the public website (/) using scroll-driven reveals, kinetic typography for key messages, and seamless page transitions to build enterprise credibility.
motion.transitions: Instant or 200ms structural transitions in the staff shell to feel powerful and responsive. Complex, organic morphing reserved exclusively for the Treatment Readiness Graph to highlight causal resolution.
motion.microinteractions: Clear, high-contrast focus states and instant feedback on deterministic state engine interactions. Subtle pulse effects on active blockers.
motion.reduced_motion: Full prefers-reduced-motion compliance with instant state toggles. Heavy animations fallback to simple opacity fades.

responsive.notes: Staff shell optimized for desktop/tablet landscape (1024px+) with dense data presentation. Public site, sign-in, patient, and caregiver portals are fully responsive, scaling down to 320px mobile viewports with no loss of critical actions.

application_states: Public/Unauthenticated: High-credibility public website with catchy animations, trust center, and sign-in.
Staff App Shell - Command Center: High-level operational synthetic overview.
Staff App Shell - Exceptions: Active deterministic state engine (Maria's case, dual-task split, triage, confirmation).
Staff App Shell - Secondary: Synthetic but complete presentation of Insights, Integrations, Resources, and Admin.
Patient Portal: Maria's active readiness check (Action Required -> Validation -> Plan Confirmed).
Caregiver Portal: Ana's permission-filtered view of confirmed ride without clinical exposure.
Deterministic Reset: Global state reset restoring Maria's baseline scenario.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA contrast ratios strictly enforced.
Explicit navigation labels and ARIA landmarks in the staff shell.
No reliance on color alone for readiness states or exceptions.
Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements without relying on generic SaaS glows.
assets_or_dependencies: Lucide React (clinical and enterprise system icons)
Tailwind CSS (utility classes, structural layouts, strict enterprise tokens)
design_system_changes: Expanded docs/design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md to define the persistent enterprise staff shell, distinct patient/caregiver portal containers, and public website structural tokens.
notes_for_codex: Expanded scope incorporates a full enterprise product suite with a persistent staff application shell.
Generic SaaS patterns (gradients, tiny uppercase, role cards, fake pricing) have been explicitly banned.

Core interactive workflow (Exceptions, Patient, Caregiver) remains wired to the deterministic state engine; all new top-level destinations (Insights, integrations, etc.) will use credible synthetic presentation.
The Treatment Readiness Graph, owned action workflow, caregiver permission boundary, and causal audit timeline are established as the defining product language.
Ready for Codex compatibility review and canonical SHA256 digest binding.
